title: New Wave
tagline: Catchy hooks, sharp synths, and a future-facing edge.
summary: New wave emerged as punk's more stylized and electronic cousin. It fused direct pop songwriting with a strong design sense, synth textures, and a love of movement on stage. The genre carried punk's attitude into polished production and art-school cool, creating a bridge between club culture, radio, and post-punk experimentation.

pillars.name: The Cure
pillars.why: The Cure brought a melodic, emotionally open sensibility to new wave while keeping its edge intact.

pillars.name: Talking Heads
pillars.why: Talking Heads made rhythmic tension and clever lyrics central to the movement's appeal.

pillars.name: Devo
pillars.why: Devo pushed the movement toward theatricality and concept, using odd rhythms and cool minimalism to make new wave feel strange and forward-looking.
